Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

hide verb

a thing, or a fact

also conceal, keep secret, keep from, stash, hide away, cover up

classical

Plaut. Bacch. 375–376: ut cēlem patrem … tua flāgitia
Cic. Fam. 2.16.3: nōn tē cēlāvī sermōnem T. Ampiī (Lewis & Short)

cēlō, cēlāre, cēlāvī, cēlātum

verb, first conjugation: with two accusatives, cēlāre aliquem aliquid

hide something, keep it secret; keep someone in the dark about it

Other words

  • occultō, occultāre, occultāvī, occultātum — keep hidden, keep out of sight

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Plaut. Aul. 277: quod cēlātum atque occultātum est ūsque adhūc; Plaut. Trin. 3.2.1 (Lewis & Short)

  • abstrūdō, abstrūdere, abstrūsī, abstrūsum — thrust away out of sight, stash away

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Plaut. Aul. 583: ibi abstrūdam probē; Cic. Att. 12.15: māne mē in silvam abstrūsī dēnsam (Lewis & Short)

  • abdō, abdere, abdidī, abditum — put away, hide; sē abdere, hide oneself

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.126: eās contēxit atque abdidit (nātūra) (Lewis & Short); Cic. Pis. 39: amīcī tabellās (Lewis & Short)

  • abscondō, abscondere, abscondī (abscondidī), absconditum — put carefully out of sight, hide away

    conjugation · also used · classical · Plaut. Merc. 360: nēquīquam abdidī, abscondidī, abstrūsam habēbam; Cic. Rosc. Am. 41: quō studiōsius ab istīs opprimitur et absconditur (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • nunc hoc mihi factū est optumum, ut tēd auferam, aula, in Fideī fānum: ibi abstrūdam probē

    the best thing I can do now, pot, is to carry you off to the shrine of Faith: I’ll hide you well away therePlaut. Aul. 582–583

  • quod cēlātum atque occultātum est ūsque adhūc, nunc nōn potest

    what has been kept secret and hidden until now can be hidden no longerPlaut. Aul. 277

  • nēquīquam abdidī, abscondidī, abstrūsam habēbam

    in vain I hid her, put her away, kept her tucked out of sightPlaut. Merc. 360

See also hide, secretly, hide and seek.
